darshak.title: Darshak (Viewer)
darshak.desc: Live neelami dekhna, khiladiyon ke stats inspect karna aur spectator mode.
darshak.can_do: Live bidding rooms real-time mein watch karein
darshak.cannot_do: Boli (bid) nahi laga sakte ya admin tools nahi milenge

player.title: Player / Khiladi
player.desc: Player lot status dekhna, auction pool verification aur contract track karna.
player.can_do: Apna profile submit karke auction pool mein enter karein
player.cannot_do: Dusre khiladiyon ya teams par boli nahi laga sakte

team_owner.title: Team Owner (Malik)
team_owner.desc: Live bidding buttons active, purse budget management aur squad banana.
team_owner.can_do: Live room mein bid lagayein aur team budget manage karein
team_owner.cannot_do: Individually khiladi ke roop mein pool mein nahi ja sakte

admin.title: SuperAdmin
admin.desc: Full auction gavel controls, participant KYC approvals aur sports catalog.
admin.can_do: Hammer strike se Sold/Unsold karein aur tournaments chalayein
admin.cannot_do: Ek bidder ke roop mein boli nahi laga sakte
